comment: Real aerial photos the simulated payload camera shows where they cover the ground (the rest is drawn from the OSM map). Openly licensed drone orthomosaics from OpenAerialMap; the .tif files are fetched once by scripts/fetch-imagery.ps1 and git-ignored. 'role': 'ground' images are drawn as terrain; 'vehicles' images are only a source of real vehicle photos for scenario objects (see Simulator:VehiclePhotos).
